cases.headline: @wen_moon_wendy funded 14 wallets before $GLORP launched. They bought in the same block.

findings.title: Fourteen wallets funded from one source
findings.detail: All fourteen received 2.0 SOL from the same wallet within 90 seconds, twelve minutes before the mint.

findings.title: Same-block buys
findings.detail: All fourteen wallets bought in the launch block. Combined, 38% of supply.

findings.title: Coordinated exit
findings.detail: Sells began nine minutes after launch and completed within four minutes.

narrative: @wen_moon_wendy is on the record for $GLORP (Glorp Protocol). The case was opened on 2026-10-10 after the agent flagged pre-funded bundle at launch.

All fourteen received 2.0 SOL from the same wallet within 90 seconds, twelve minutes before the mint. All fourteen wallets bought in the launch block. Combined, 38% of supply. Sells began nine minutes after launch and completed within four minutes.
763 SOL left the first wallet. 595 SOL arrived at the last one, labelled bridge. Everything in between is in the money trail.
Convictions: 0.

cases.headline: $WAGMIFY did 2.1M in volume on its first day. 1.7M of it was @rug_rachel trading with @rug_rachel.

findings.title: Circular transfers
findings.detail: Three wallets passed the same tokens between each other 412 times.

findings.title: Volume to holders ratio
findings.detail: Reported volume was 61x the value held by non-linked wallets.

narrative: @rug_rachel is on the record for $WAGMIFY (Wagmify). The case was opened on 2026-10-10 after the agent flagged wash volume.
Three wallets passed the same tokens between each other 412 times. Reported volume was 61x the value held by non-linked wallets.

cases.headline: Liquidity for $SNIFF was removed at 03:12. @sniperbot_ceo posted "still here" at 03:40.

findings.title: LP tokens never burned
findings.detail: The deployer kept the LP tokens despite the launch post saying otherwise.

findings.title: Removal in one transaction
findings.detail: All pooled SOL left the pool in a single instruction.

findings.title: Proceeds bridged within the hour
findings.detail: The SOL moved through two hops to a bridge deposit address.

narrative: @sniperbot_ceo is on the record for $SNIFF (Sniff Finance). The case was opened on 2026-10-13 after the agent flagged liquidity pulled.
The deployer kept the LP tokens despite the launch post saying otherwise. All pooled SOL left the pool in a single instruction. The SOL moved through two hops to a bridge deposit address.
1655 SOL left the first wallet. 1383 SOL arrived at the last one, labelled cex deposit. Everything in between is in the money trail.
Convictions: 0.
